cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md
tool_input.description: Create the TLS backend policy doc

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says the current recorded decision is rustls as the TLS backend, chosen because its implementation is cleaner. It also carries the separate recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no plaintext exceptions. It doesn't mention the retired alternative.

The decision comes from Muninn record #14, a decision you stated directly, and `muninn why` judged it sufficient. I couldn't confirm the write from the shell: the first attempt failed with a parser error, so I used the Write tool. Its "created" message is the only confirmation.

I ignored record #26 ("Withdrawing that, verification on all builds"). It only revoked #24, which is retired, and its text doesn't mention TLS.

Muninn also reported a red heartbeat: 20 hook runs started and never finished. It suggests a hook is exceeding its timeout, and `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl` has the details.
